subject: Blade Traps and fan hallway
text: In the hallway with Blade Traps and a fan, wait for the fan to stop blowing before running past the Blade Traps in Kokiri Boots.

evidence.quote:
If the fan starts blowing, then it
will push you backwards (you can fight it by running into the wind), so wait
for it to stop blowing, then run past the Blade Traps.  If you equip the Iron
Boots, then the fan can't affect you (but you'll also move too slowly to get
past the Blade Traps, so stick with the Kokiri Boots).

subject: Big Skulltula
text: A Big Skulltula hangs from the ceiling around the corner in the hallway.

evidence.quote: Go around the corner and kill the Big Skulltula that hangs from the ceiling.

subject: Powerful fan hallway
text: Equipping the Iron Boots stabilizes Link against the hallway's powerful fan while walking toward the pit.

evidence.quote:
The fan in this hallway is more powerful, and DOES have the ability to push you
backwards, even if you fight it.  So use the Iron Boots to stabilize yourself,
and walk slowly around the corner, where you will find another fan and a large
pit.

subject: Pit across ledge
text: Link can pull himself across the large pit to the opposite ledge by using the Longshot while keeping the Iron Boots equipped.

evidence.quote:
Keeping the Iron Boots equipped, use the Longshot on the opposite ledge
above the pit to pull yourself across.

subject: Silver Eye
text: Holding down the Z Button and keeping the shield up while walking forward blocks flames spit by the Silver Eye above the door.

evidence.quote:
The Silver Eye above the door on the
other end of the hall will spit fire at you, so hold down the Z Button and
keep your shield up while walking forward to block the flames.

subject: Fake wall ledge
text: Switching to the Hover Boots by the last fan on the right wall allows the wind to blow Link through a fake wall on the left onto a ledge.

evidence.quote:
When you reach
the last fan on the right wall, change from the Iron Boots to the Hover Boots.
With the help of the Hover Boots, the fan will blow you through a fake wall on
the left and onto a ledge.  Go through the door on the other side of the wall.

subject: Gibdos chest
text: Defeating the Gibdos in the room while dodging Blade Traps causes a chest containing a Blue Rupee to appear.

evidence.quote:
Change back to the Kokiri Boots, then kill the Gibdos in this room while
dodging the Blade Traps on the floor, and a chest will appear.  Open it for a
Blue Rupee

subject: Rubble chest
text: Bombing the rubble pile in the southeast corner and using the Lens of Truth reveals a hidden chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
bomb the pile of rubble in the southeast corner of the room.
Use the Lens of Truth to see the chest beneath the rubble, and open it to get a
Small Key.

subject: Stone block
text: In the room with the fog river, push or pull the large stone block along the floor track into the small trench near the ladder.

evidence.quote:
Look to the left as you enter the room to see a large stone block.  Grab it and
push/pull it along the track in the floor to the small trench near the ladder,
to the right of the door you came through.

subject: Southwest alcove
text: A Gold Skulltula token is in a southwest alcove visible from the front of the boat, reachable with the Longshot or Scarecrow's Song.

evidence.quote:
go to the front of the boat, and look to the southwest.
You'll see an alcove with a Gold Skulltula in it.  You can use the Scarecrow's
Song to make Pierre appear up in that alcove, or you can just shoot the
Skulltula from the boat with the Longshot.

subject: Cursed Boat
text: Standing on the Triforce symbol on the boat and playing Zelda's Lullaby causes the boat to begin moving west.

evidence.quote:
return to the Boat and stand on the Triforce symbol.  Play Zelda's
Lullaby, and the boat will begin to move.

subject: Stalfos
text: Several waves of Stalfos attack as the boat travels west across the fog river.

evidence.quote: As the boat moves west, you'll have to fight off several waves of Stalfos.

subject: Cursed Boat
text: When the boat reaches the west side of the room, Link must immediately jump off the south side onto shore before the boat sinks.

evidence.quote:
Once the boat reaches the west side of the room, immediately jump
off the south side of the boat onto the shore.  Because the boat is going to
sink.

subject: Floor Master Room
text: Using the Lens of Truth reveals the invisible maze walls in the Floor Master Room.

evidence.quote:
In
actuality, this room is a simple rudimentary maze.  The catch is, the walls are
invisible.  Use the Lens of Truth to see the invisible walls.

subject: Crushing walls
text: Using Din's Fire burns both of the spike-covered wooden walls crushing toward Link.

evidence.quote:
This room contains two walls, each covered with spikes, both of which are
crushing towards you.  This would be a problem, except for the fact that both
of the walls are made of wood.  Use Din's Fire to burn them both.

subject: Ornate chest
text: Killing the Redead on the east side of the Crushing Walls Room allows Link to open an ornate chest containing the Boss Key.

evidence.quote:
Go to the
east side of the room, and kill the Redead.  Open the ornate chest to get the
Boss Key.

subject: West chest
text: The chest on the west side of the Crushing Walls Room contains a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote: The chest on the west side of the room contains a Blue Rupee.

subject: Floor Master Room south door
text: Navigating around the invisible walls to the south side of the Floor Master Room leads to the door of the Invisible Floor Master Room.

evidence.quote:
Make your way around the invisible walls to the south side of the room, and go
through the door there.

subject: Invisible Floor Master
text: Using the Lens of Truth reveals the invisible Floor Master, and Din's Fire quickly kills the three invisible midget Floor Masters it splits into.

evidence.quote:
This room contains an invisible Floor Master.  Use the Lens of Truth to see it.
Once you defeat it, it will split into three midget Floor Masters (who are also
invisible), which will grow full size if you don't kill them quickly.  Use
Din's Fire to quickly kill all three.

subject: Invisible Floor Master chest
text: Defeating the invisible Floor Master and its spawn causes a chest containing a Small Key to appear in the rear of the room.

evidence.quote:
Once the Floor Master and his spawn are
dead, a chest appears in the rear of the room.  Open it to get a Small Key,
then return to the previous room.

subject: Floor Master Room west door
text: Navigating around the invisible walls to the west side of the Floor Master Room leads through the door to the Triple Skull Room.

evidence.quote:
Make your way around the invisible walls to the west side of the room, and go
through the door there.

subject: Triple Skull Room wall
text: A Gold Skulltula token is located on the wall behind the three rotating skulls in the Triple Skull Room.

evidence.quote:
This room is similar to the Skull Room you passed previously, but has three
rotating Skulls in it.  You don't actually have to destroy any of them, unless
you want lots of rupees.  Nail the Gold Skulltula on the wall behind the
Skulls, take it's token, then return to the previous room.

subject: Floor Master Room east door
text: Navigating around the invisible walls to the east side of the Floor Master Room leads through the door on that side.

evidence.quote:
Make your way around the invisible walls to the east side of the room, and go
through the door there.

subject: Bomb flower pillar
text: Shooting a Fire Arrow at one of the bomb flowers surrounding the tall pillar across the pit causes the pillar to fall and form a bridge across the gap.

evidence.quote:
On the left side of the ledge opposite the pit, there is a
tall pillar which is surrounded by bomb flowers.  Nail one of the bomb flowers
with a Fire Arrow, and the pillar will fall down, making a bridge leading
across the gap.

subject: Geometric Shape Room
text: Equipping the Hover Boots and using the Lens of Truth allows Link to cross invisible platforms to reach the ledge with the Boss Door.

evidence.quote:
Equip the Hover Boots and use the Lens of Truth to see the platforms in this
room.  Run out to the T-Shaped platform directly in front of the door, then go
to the left to the straight platform.  From there, go right to the next
platform, and then to the ledge with the Boss Door.

subject: Bongo Bongo
text: Dropping into the pit in the middle of the room begins the boss fight against Bongo Bongo on a giant bongo drum.

evidence.quote:
-------------B-O-S-S-------------
Phantom Shadow Beast BONGO BONGO...Drop down the pit in the
middle of the room to begin the fight.

The entire boss fight is fought on a giant drum.

subject: Bongo Bongo
text: Equipping the Kokiri Boots avoids making the boss fight against Bongo Bongo unnecessarily difficult.

evidence.quote:
Just make sure you're using the
Kokiri Boots, otherwise this fight will be unnecessarily difficult.

subject: Bongo Bongo
text: Quickly shooting both of Bongo Bongo's hands with arrows using Z-Targeting stuns them and makes his eye appear.

evidence.quote:
To damage Bongo Bongo, you must make his eye appear.  To do this, shoot both of
his hands with arrows to stun them.  They recover quickly, so shoot fast.  Use
Z-Targeting; the hands move much too fast, and the constant movement of the
drum makes manual aiming pretty much impossible.

subject: Bongo Bongo
text: Looking between Bongo Bongo's stunned hands with the Lens of Truth reveals his eye, which can be shot with an arrow before attacking his fallen torso with a Biggoron Sword Jump Attack.

evidence.quote:
Once you stun both hands, use
the Lens of Truth to look at the space between the hands, and you'll see Bongo
Bongo's eye.  Shoot it with an Arrow as well, and Bongo Bongo's torso will fall
to the floor, letting you attack it.  As always, that attack should be a Jump
Attack from the Biggoron Sword

subject: Bongo Bongo
text: Stunning Bongo Bongo's hands causes them to drop more magic or arrows if Link runs low.

evidence.quote:
If you run low on
magic or arrows, Bongo Bongo's hands drop more when you stun them.

subject: Heart Container
text: Bongo Bongo leaves behind a Heart Container upon defeat.

evidence.quote: Take the Heart Container that Bongo Bongo leaves behind

subject: Impa
text: Entering the beam of light after defeating Bongo Bongo awakens Impa as the Sage of Shadow and awards Link the Shadow Medallion.

evidence.quote:
New Quest Item: Shadow Medallion...enter the beam of
light to meet the Sage of Shadow: Impa

subject: Gerudo Fortress gate
text: The gate in the northwest corner of the Gerudo Fortress leads to the Haunted Wasteland once Link has obtained the Bow and Epona.

evidence.quote:
This part of the guide can be finished immediately after obtaining the Bow and
Epona, so you may have finished it already.  If you have, then head for the
Haunted Wasteland through the gate in the northwest corner of the Gerudo
Fortress immediately.

subject: Kakariko Graveyard
text: After warping back to Kakariko Graveyard from the Chamber of the Sages, head to Hyrule Field and travel west to Gerudo Valley.

evidence.quote:
After you warp back here from the Chamber of the Sages, then head for Hyrule
Field and go to Gerudo Valley, in the west side of the Field.
